findings.detail: Client entered held refusal barrier before WAIT_INPUT while server awaited INJECT, so original coordinator would never release either. Add explicit early INJECT to reach barrier and a later INPUT_READY before actual virtual input.
Retain actual replacement client configuration after startup credential switch, not only source-generated expected policy.
Require exact occurrence counts for the per-epoch virtual counter substitutions.
